title: iFLYTEK Spark X2.5 Officially Released with a Total of 293 Billion Parameters and Comprehensive Upgrades
summary: iFLYTEK releases the Spark X2.5 large model, which adopts a Mixture of Experts architecture, with a total of 293 billion parameters and only 30 billion activated during inference, balancing efficiency and performance improvements. It focuses on enhancing code generation and intelligent agent interaction, as well as strengthening general capabilities such as mathematical computation and semantic understanding, and fully supports 256K long context processing.
